description: Read the workspace audit log, newest first: who did what and when, including who decided each approval. Filter by action, subject_kind and subject_id, agent_id or since; pass the returned cursor to page on. The team's own rows are for owners and admins. Needs a Last Price credential with audit read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

action.description: Only events with this action, e.g. approval.approve.

agent_id.description: Only events caused by this agent.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous page returned.

limit.description: Most events to return. Defaults to 50.

since.description: Only events at or after this time.

subject_id.description: Only events about this subject id.

subject_kind.description: Only events about this kind of subject.

name: list_audit_events
